items.problem: The mandatory scaffold/bootstrap/self-check sequence was parallelized, causing bootstrap to run before its target existed.
items.evidence: session-log.txt turn 1 issued all three PowerShell calls together; bootstrap threw Target not found and Test-Path returned False before dotnet new completed.
items.covered_at: SKILL.md, Step 0 - Bootstrap (mandatory), especially 'your literal first three powershell commands' and 'Proceed past step 3 only if Test-Path returns True'.
items.proposed_improvement: State that the commands are strict dependencies and must run sequentially, one tool call at a time, waiting for success before issuing the next.
items.generalizes: Scaffolding is asynchronous enough that any migration can race bootstrap and self-check when an agent follows general parallel-tool guidance.
